+package config
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"io/ioutil"
+	"net/http/httptest"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+// A missing metadata section must keep update checks enabled for existing files.
+func TestMetadataDefaultsToCheckingForUpdates(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, cfg := range []*Config{Default(), loadMetadataTestConfig(t, "config.yml", "log:\n  level: INFO\n")} {
+		assertMetadataCheckForUpdates(t, cfg, true)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestLoadMetadataCheckForUpdatesFromYAML(t *testing.T) {
+	cfg := loadMetadataTestConfig(t, "config.yml", "metadata:\n  check_for_updates: false\n")
+	assertMetadataCheckForUpdates(t, cfg, false)
+}
+
+func TestLoadMetadataCheckForUpdatesFromJSON(t *testing.T) {
+	cfg := loadMetadataTestConfig(t, "config.json", `{"metadata":{"check_for_updates":false}}`)
+	assertMetadataCheckForUpdates(t, cfg, false)
+}
+
+func loadMetadataTestConfig(t *testing.T, name, contents string) *Config {
+	t.Helper()
+	dir, err := ioutil.TempDir("", "flipt-metadata-test-")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	defer os.RemoveAll(dir)
+	path := filepath.Join(dir, name)
+	require.NoError(t, ioutil.WriteFile(path, []byte(contents), 0600))
+	cfg, err := Load(path)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	return cfg
+}
+
+func assertMetadataCheckForUpdates(t *testing.T, cfg *Config, want bool) {
+	t.Helper()
+	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
+	cfg.ServeHTTP(w, httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/config", nil))
+	require.Equal(t, 200, w.Code)
+	var response struct {
+		Metadata struct {
+			CheckForUpdates *bool `json:"checkForUpdates"`
+		} `json:"metadata"`
+	}
+	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(w.Body.Bytes(), &response))
+	require.NotNil(t, response.Metadata.CheckForUpdates, "metadata.checkForUpdates must be present")
+	require.Equal(t, want, *response.Metadata.CheckForUpdates)
+}
